entity: Institute of Archeology and Anthropology, University of South Carolina
role: Conducting archaeological survey of proposed reservoir area
stance_basis: survey concluded no sites jeopardized but recommended ongoing monitoring
summary: The Institute of Archeology and Anthropology, University of South Carolina, conducted an archaeological survey of the proposed Bad Creek reservoir area, concluding that no historical or prehistorical sites would be jeopardized by the project. The survey did recommend that the Institute be kept informed of construction activities in case clearing operations uncover any archaeological sites, and the Applicant accepted this recommendation. The survey's scope did not extend to the proposed transmission line corridor.
complaint_summary: The Institute's survey, conducted by John D. Combes, found no historical or prehistorical sites would be jeopardized by the Bad Creek Project, but recommended the Institute be kept informed of construction activities in case archaeological sites are uncovered during clearing operations.
